response_convergence_assessment: No clear magnitude convergence within 6000/12000/24000: the median response is non-monotonic and seed spread remains material. The 24000-particle level does show the best temporal-window stability and the lowest seed CV of the three tested levels, but not convergence to a unique scalar.

boundary_assessment.interpretation: Global independent holdout is robust across all realizations. The strict local 5% gate is not uniformly satisfied; failures remain concentrated in feed/transition regions and become less severe at higher particle count.

temporal_estimator_assessment.interpretation: Temporal/coherent-estimator robustness improves strongly with particle count (0/3, 1/3, 3/3 stable at 6000, 12000, 24000 respectively).

final_response_characterization.recommended_characterization: highest-sampling three-seed long-window coherent response distribution
final_response_characterization.interpretation: Strong O(10) coherent plasma modification is reproducible in scale, but the precise projected-moment ratio is realization dependent and must not be presented as a unique converged scalar.

supported: The corrected atomic two-way solver remained finite and dynamically stable in all nine article-scale sensitivity realizations.
Global independent boundary residual remained below 5% in all nine realizations.
At 24000 particles/species, all three seeds had stable final-8/9/10-cycle coherent estimates.
The plasma produces a strong O(10) modification of the auxiliary-source axial moment relative to matched vacuum.
The precise coherent response magnitude is seed/sampling dependent.
not_supported: A unique particle-converged scalar plasma/vacuum response ratio.
Uniform <5% local boundary error for every seed and every named region.
A calibrated port current, impedance, admittance, S-parameter, or sheath-response coefficient.

next_step: Freeze numerical parameters and move to manuscript/reviewer-response revision. Use the 24000-particle three-seed distribution as the highest-sampling response characterization; report local feed-transition boundary exceedances explicitly. Do not run further particle/seed/parameter sweeps.
